WITH env_data AS (
    SELECT 
        eh.envhealthregistry,
        eh.env_dist_ref,
        eh.health_environment_profile->'health'->>'disease_risk' as disease_risk,
        (eh.health_environment_profile->'environment'->>'sanitation_coverage')::real as sanitation_coverage,
        (regexp_replace(eh.health_environment_profile->'environment'->>'water_quality_index', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'))::real as water_quality_index
    FROM environmentandhealth eh
),
hr_data AS (
    SELECT 
        hr.hrdistref,
        hr.hr_ops_ref,
        (hr.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical')::int as medical_personnel
    FROM humanresources hr
),
dist_data AS (
    SELECT 
        d.distregistry,
        COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'casualties')::int, 0) as casualties,
        COALESCE((d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'injured')::int, 0) as injured
    FROM disasterevents d
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        ed.envhealthregistry,
        ed.env_dist_ref,
        hr.hr_ops_ref,
        hr.medical_personnel,
        dd.casualties,
        dd.injured,
        CASE WHEN (dd.casualties + dd.injured) = 0 THEN NULL 
             ELSE hr.medical_personnel::numeric / (dd.casualties + dd.injured)::numeric 
        END as MSR,
        ed.disease_risk,
        ed.sanitation_coverage,
        ed.water_quality_index
    FROM env_data ed
    JOIN hr_data hr ON ed.env_dist_ref = hr.hrdistref
    JOIN dist_data dd ON ed.env_dist_ref = dd.distregistry
),
phrs_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        CASE 
            WHEN disease_risk = 'High' THEN 3
            WHEN disease_risk = 'Medium' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END as disease_risk_score,
        100 - sanitation_coverage as sanitation_risk,
        100 - water_quality_index as water_quality_risk
    FROM combined
)
SELECT 
    opsregistry as hr_ops_ref,
    disease_risk,
    ROUND(CAST(MSR AS numeric), 4) as MSR,
    disease_risk_score,
    ROUND(CAST(sanitation_risk AS numeric), 2) as sanitation_risk,
    ROUND(CAST(water_quality_risk AS numeric), 2) as water_quality_risk,
    ROUND(CAST((((1 - COALESCE(MSR, 0)) * 40) + (disease_risk_score * 10) + (sanitation_risk * 0.15) + (water_quality_risk * 0.15)) AS numeric), 2) as PHRS
FROM phrs_calc
ORDER BY PHRS DESC;
